title: vitis trifoliata var. alata
intro: Vitis trifoliata var. alata, commonly known as the Chinese mountain grapevine, is a plant species that belongs to the Vitaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Vitis trifoliata var. alata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
